settings.text: New drop every Friday · Free 3-day shipping & returns

settings.heading: By sneakerheads, for sneakerheads
settings.body: We got tired of fakes, inflated resale and bots hoovering up every pair. So we built the shop we wanted — verified product, fair prices and a fresh drop every week that real people can actually get.

settings.heading: Every pair, verified
settings.body: Our team inspects each pair against the details that matter — stitching, materials, box and tags — before it ever ships. If it's not perfect and genuine, it doesn't leave the building.

settings.heading: Nail your size, first time
settings.body: Every product page shows the true-to-size guidance and a brand-by-brand conversion chart. Between sizes? We tell you which way to go — and returns are free if we get it wrong.

blocks.question: Are your sneakers authentic?
blocks.answer: 100%. Every pair is sourced through trusted channels and inspected by our team before shipping. If anything's ever off, you're refunded in full — no questions.

blocks.question: How does the weekly drop work?
blocks.answer: New pairs go live every Friday in limited quantities. Subscribe for early access and restock alerts so you don't miss the styles you're after.

blocks.question: How do I get my size right?
blocks.answer: Check the true-to-size note and conversion chart on each product page. If you're between sizes we recommend which way to go — and returns are free if it's not right.

blocks.question: What are shipping and returns like?
blocks.answer: Free 3-day tracked shipping on every order, and free returns within 30 days on unworn pairs in the original box.

blocks.question: Can I track my order?
blocks.answer: Yes — you'll get tracking by email and SMS as soon as your pair ships, and you can follow it from your account any time.
